results.description: The complete collapse signature survives independently evolving latent depth and depth-independent observation timing in at least 16 of 20 confirmatory seeds.
results.label: weak_support

results.description: Flat, reversed, and non-monotone generative volatility mappings each produce the complete collapse signature in at most 4 of 20 confirmatory seeds.
results.label: null

results.description: At least half of the preregistered 3x3x3x3 joint safety-prior, likelihood-matrix, beta/gamma, and policy-gain grid retains the transition in at least 80 percent of seeds.
results.label: falsified

results.description: A likelihood fit on the first half of the confirmatory seeds recovers autonomous latent depth on the held-out second half with mean trajectory correlation at least 0.6.
results.label: support
